# Radio Group

A set of checkable buttons where no more than one of the buttons can be checked at a time.

Exports from `uiofcraft` and `uiofcraft/radio-group`: `Radio`, `RadioGroup`, `RadioGroupItem`, `RadioGroupPrimitive`, `RadioPrimitive`.

## Usage

```tsx
import { Label } from "uiofcraft"
import { Radio, RadioGroup } from "uiofcraft"
```

```tsx
<RadioGroup defaultValue="next">
  <Label>
    <Radio value="next" /> Next.js
  </Label>
  <Label>
    <Radio value="vite" /> Vite
  </Label>
  <Label>
    <Radio value="astro" /> Astro
  </Label>
</RadioGroup>
```

## API Reference

### RadioGroup

Root component. Styled wrapper for `RadioGroup.Root` from Base UI with flex column layout.

### Radio

Individual radio button. Styled wrapper for `Radio.Root` from Base UI with built-in indicator. Also exported as `RadioGroupItem`.
